text:
Marco Silva: FYI EdgeWay reported a negative invoice for March, looks like a promo engine applied a trial credit twice. Can finance take a look?
CostBot: Invoice INV-2026-411 created 2026-03-15T09:11:02Z. Negative balance detected: -$3,250. Possible promo double-apply by promo-service:v2.3.
Nina Park: Oof. Account acct_ew_12. I pulled the invoice lines: 
```
1) usage: dedicated_capacity 1x 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 $5,000
2) promo_trial_50pct -$2,500
3) promo_trial_50pct -$2,500 (duplicate)
Total: -$3,250
```
Jared Moss: Thanks Nina. EdgeWay prefers cash refund to the bank on file. We normally issue account credits for promos, but negative invoice complicates revenue recognition. Need finance lead approval for cash refund > $1k.
Marco Silva: Are we sure it's a promo-service bug and not a manual adjustment?
Nina Park: Promo-service created two entries with same promo_id: promo_trial_march_50 and same correlation_id; looks like webhook retried and promo-service didn't dedupe. I can patch promo-service to ignore retries, but that won't fix posted invoice.
BillingBot: Created adjustment suggestion ADJ-2102: reverse duplicate promo line and create credit memo or cash refund depending on finance decision.
Jared Moss: Proposal: refund $3,250 cash to EdgeWay, then re-run billing to post correct invoice of $2,500. Alternatively, if finance wants to avoid cash movement, issue CM-2102 credit memo applied to future invoices and ask customer if they'd accept. Which path?
Marco Silva: EdgeWay insists on cash. They're a small MSP and accounting team needs zero balance. They escalated to our sales lead. Prefers cash refund.
Nina Park: Tax note: cash refunds require reversing revenue and issuing RFC-024 to G/L 4-701. Credit memos use G/L 4-520. We need approver sign-off for RFC.
Jared Moss: Can finance approve up to $5k cash for partner escalations? If yes I'll route payment.
CostBot: Historic policy threshold: cash refunds > $2,000 require VP-Finance sign-off. Requests between $1,000 and $2,000 can be approved by Finance Manager. This request is $3,250.
Marco Silva: OK routing: Nina, prepare RFC-024 with impact calc and tag AR ticket ZD-9954. I'll loop in VP-Finance (Teresa) for approval.
Nina Park: RFC-024 drafted, included GL impact, tax reversal, and suggested refund method (ACH). Attached reconciliation snapshot and promo-service logs in ZD-9954.
Jared Moss: VP-Finance Teresa: please review ZD-9954 and approve cash refund for EdgeWay $3,250. Sales (+Marco) already confirmed customer wants cash.
BillingBot: Payment request PR-442 queued pending approval.
Teresa Lambert: (via email, pasted) Reviewed RFC-024 and logs. Approve one-time cash refund of $3,250 to EdgeWay. Finance will record reversal to GL 4-701 and tag refund reference REF-2026-334. Please confirm funds transfer method and add merchant banking note.
Nina Park: Approved. I'll mark ADJ-2102 as "cash_refund_approved" and post CM placeholder referencing REF-2026-334 for audit trail.
CostBot: REF-2026-334 issued at 2026-03-15T13:02:45Z. Payment PR-442 executed via ACH to EdgeWay bank ending 2241 at 2026-03-15T14:10:03Z.
Jared Moss: Customer confirmed receipt of funds and sent a payment confirmation screenshot to Sales.
Marco Silva: EdgeWay also okayed us keeping the promo fix as a backend patch. Nina, can you add a post-mortem note and mitigation: idempotency key on promo webhook?
Nina Park: Yup. I'll add dedupe on correlation_id and a retry-safe handler. Also adding an automated billing check to flag negative totals before invoice finalize.
BillingBot: ADJ-2102 closed. ZD-9954 updated with REF-2026-334 and PR-442.
Marco Silva: Thanks team. Filing final docs under /billing/credits/2026/REF-2026-334.pdf and notifying Sales to update contract notes. Thread closed :white_check_mark:
